string-array.name: tips_joycreator
string-array.item: Everything you make is saved in your Joy Creator folder as ordinary files you can see, copy and back up.
Deleted something by mistake? Hold the Joy Creator logo at the top of the lobby to open Recently deleted.
Tap the search glass in the lobby to find any project, recording, drawing or picture in your Library.
Hold anything in the Library to see everything you can do with it.
Share a video, picture or sound into Joy Creator from any app and it lands in your folder, ready for Studio.
Tap Joybot for an idea about what you are working on. To chat with your own AI, connect it in Settings, AI and Joybot.
TextLab makes movie-poster titles. In Studio, tap Edit in TextLab beside a title\'s look to change it there.
Open a .joypack file to add new looks and fonts. Tap Packs at the bottom of the lobby to see what you have.
Tap the storage line in the lobby to see what is using room on your phone and get some back.
Search Settings for what you want to change, like \"watermark\" or \"theme\".
Viz Lab turns your music into moving visuals, built from parts you can mix and tweak.
